rationale: All four prior findings are addressed: CR-001 (ResponseReadyAnnouncer.tsx always renders the live region and fills text only while pending), CR-003 (responseReady.ts wraps showNotification() in try/catch inside markResponseReady, so no throw escapes stream completion), CR-004 (responseReady.ts records a non-granted permission result in a session flag and skips further requests). CR-002 (A2UI-only completion observed through polling stays silent) is an accepted gap by user decision, not a fix: the text guard in lastTurnFinishedWithResponse is intentionally unchanged because it is what keeps a failed generation from signalling, and the poll payload carries no terminal-completion flag. No new findings raised; this round verifies only the prior ids per contract.

business_review.notes: markResponseReady sets pending only when document.hidden; stream finalize, reconnect and poll paths all reach it.
ResponseReadyAnnouncer keeps the sr-only <output> mounted and renders 'AI response ready' only while pending (CR-001 fixed).

business_review.item: Feature must not disrupt streaming or error handling
business_review.notes: Notification construction is guarded by try/catch in markResponseReady (CR-003 fixed); permission request failures are caught.

business_review.item: Permission prompt does not interrupt on every submit
business_review.notes: notificationDeclinedThisSession short-circuits requestNotificationPermission after a dismissed or denied result (CR-004 fixed).

business_review.item: A2UI-only (text-less) completion via polling does not signal ready (CR-002)
business_review.notes: Accepted gap by user decision. The empty-text guard separates a failed generation from a completed one when the poll payload carries no completion flag; the stream path is unaffected and still signals on the terminal last chunk. Recorded by a comment at src/store/chats.ts above lastTurnFinishedWithResponse.
